maintenance_orders.description: Inspect Cylinder #2 cooling shroud and baffle elastomeric seals for tears, deformation, or dislodgement.

final_pilot_directive: Enrich fuel trim +12%, reduce throttle to 4,600 RPM, and initiate descent to cooler ambient air.
root_cause: Cooling baffle seal displacement on Cylinder #2 shroud leading to localized thermal boundary layer separation and progressive CHT runaway.
emergency_checklist: Step 1: Throttle back to 4,600 RPM (loiter power) to reduce heat rejection.
Step 2: Command +12% fuel enrichment to lower combustion chamber temperatures.
Step 3: Descend 3,000–5,000 ft into denser, cooler ambient air.
Step 4: If CHT exceeds 135°C, vector toward nearest recovery waypoint.
closing_maintenance_order: Inspect Cylinder #2 cooling shroud and baffle elastomeric seals for tears, deformation, or dislodgement.
